title: Signal-fused staggered promote with chaos-window safeguards
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: Progressive promotes and canaries at Redwood have historically used single-metric gates (latency or error-rate) which are too brittle for modern multi-objective SLAs. This PR adds a signal-fusion layer to the promote controller and a short-lived "chaos window" that intentionally exercises fallback/rollback paths during the canary so we validate live recovery logic before a full promote.

What this change does (high-level): Adds a new 'staggered promote' flow that advances traffic in small overlapping waves while continuously fusing multiple signals (latency, p50/p95 delta, model-quality regressions from eval hooks, and cost-per-token). Introduces a configurable 'chaos_window' phase inside the canary that will, for a bounded duration and traffic fraction, inject small perturbations (latency jitter or synthetic error responses) to ensure routing fallbacks, model-variant swap, and autoscaler responses behave as expected. If the chaos window surfaces incorrect rollback behavior or metric liveness issues, the promote controller will pause and escalate.

Technical changes: - rollout/api/v1/rollout.proto: extend RolloutSpec with 'staggered_waves' (count, overlap_pct, wave_duration) and 'chaos_window' block (enabled, duration_seconds, perturbation_profile). The fields are additive and optional. - rollout/controller.go: new stage machine for Wave -> ChaosWindow -> Observe -> Commit/Abort. Signal fusion engine implemented as a pluggable aggregator that normalizes and weights signals (configurable weights per Linear ticket ENG-2187). - rollout/chaos_window.go: deterministic small-scope perturbation generator (no random seeds from global RNG) and safe guards to limit perturbations to non-destructive types (latency inject, 5xx emulation only for mirrored/shadow traffic). - routing/sessions.go: sticky session mapping updated so that sessions started in a wave get affinity for the duration of the rollout; when a rollback occurs we provide a rewind mapping so affected sessions are not split mid-conversation. - observability/metrics/rollout_metrics.sql and metrics emitted in controller: fused_signal_score, chaos_window_activations, wave_commit_latency, rollback_reason_code. - test/integration/promote_sim_test.go and e2e harness updates to simulate staggered waves and chaos windows.

Compatibility and safety notes: - Defaults preserves existing behavior: chaos_window is off and staggered_waves defaults to a single wave with zero overlap so there is no behavior change for existing rollouts. - Chaos window perturbations are constrained: they are only enabled for rollouts with 'mirror' enabled (shadow capture) or for internal staging clusters by default; enabling in prod requires rollout-level opt-in + safety label. - Sticky session changes are backwards compatible; a rollout that doesn't opt into staggered_waves uses existing routing.

How we validated: - Unit tests cover signal fusion edge cases and aggregation weighting. - Integration tests run 10k simulated sessions through staggered waves with a configured chaos profile and assert deterministic rollback paths. - Ran the new promote_sim locally and in perf-canary; observed that a synthetic 150ms injected tail latency in wave 2 triggered the controller to pause and then resume after the fallback model variant took over (timeline included in commits).

Migration and operator notes: - New rollout proto fields are additive; the console will surface them as advanced rollout controls (UI work in a follow-up PR). - Ops should monitor the new metrics and the 'chaos_window_activations' tag to understand how often perturbations are exercised. - Enabling chaos_window in production requires a documented playbook (added to docs/rollout/chaos-window.md) and a short runbook entry for SRE.

Related: ENG-2187 (signal weights), ENG-2301 (session affinity fixes), noted in Linear.
commits: 9 commits: 1) 4d1e2b8 add staggered_waves proto and defaults; 2) b9f7c3a implement wave state machine in controller; 3) e2b6a11 chaos_window perturbation generator; 4) a7c3d55 add fused signal aggregator and basic weighting; 5) c5f2d9e session affinity adjustments and rewind map; 6) f3a9b20 emit rollout metrics for fused signals and chaos activations; 7) d4e90a2 integration tests for staggered promotes; 8) 88b0124 docs for chaos window and operator playbook; 9) 6a1f9ff fix flake in promote_sim timing (test retry) and lint fixes
review_comments:
Ravi: 'Signal fusion looks solid. Two asks: (1) add a guard to prevent chaos window from being enabled on customer-managed private installs by default; (2) add a metric that tracks the number of sessions impacted by a rollback for postmortem analysis.'
Author (Maya): 'Guard added (rollout.proto default false + onboarding label checked). Added rollback_impacted_sessions metric and emitted counts during abort path.'
Elena: 'We need tighter bounds on perturbation amplitude; 5xx emulation should not be used against production traffic unless explicitly labeled.'
Author: 'Updated generator to restrict 5xx emulation to shadow/mirrored traffic only; added config-level cap (max_perturbation_pct) and unit tests.'
Jonah: 'Integration tests look good but I saw a timing flake on promote_sim when CI runner was under load.'
Author: 'Fixed by switching to a wall-clock-backed timer and added a retry on the single flaky test.'
Final: All reviewers approved; 2 approvers required, approvals recorded in GitHub UI.
release_notes: Add staggered promote flow with signal fusion and an optional chaos-window to validate fallback/rollback paths during canaries. Defaults are safe and backward compatible. Operators: monitor fused_signal_score and chaos_window_activations metrics before enabling in production.
notes_for_release_engineering: No database migrations. Proto additive change; bump API minor version. Console UI change will be staged in a follow-up; rollout API can accept new fields immediately. Ops should schedule a short SRE rehearsal if enabling chaos_window in prod.
post_merge_tasks: - Follow-up UI PR to surface advanced rollout controls (ENG-2400). - Add SRE runbook entry to playbooks/rollouts.md. - Run a controlled canary with chaos_window enabled in staging cluster S-cluster-3 within two weeks.
example_rollout_spec:
apiVersion: redwood/v1
kind: Rollout
metadata:
  name: test-staggered
spec:
  model: text-xyz-v3
  staggered_waves:
    count: 3
    overlap_pct: 20
    wave_duration: 600
  chaos_window:
    enabled: true
    duration_seconds: 45
    perturbation_profile: latency_tail_150ms
  signal_weights:
    latency: 0.4
    p95_delta: 0.3
    model_quality: 0.2
    cost: 0.1
